caption:
You're trying so hard. It's pointing you nowhere. What if the problem was never how much you care — but which way it's all aimed? (Galatians 4:17-20 devotional)

Your effort was never the problem — its aim was. The false teachers burned hot too, but only to fence you in and bind you to themselves; real love, like Paul's labor pains, points the needle past every leader all the way to Christ being formed in you. Zeal that circles back to itself burns out; zeal aimed at Him sets you free.
